rules: A5 is the pre-specified confirmatory arm of the full Omni-Context system.
A0-A4 are ablation/causal-component arms only; they never select the final system.
Validation-driven selection is forbidden: no post-hoc selection of the highest-scoring arm, no switching to A4 if A4 scores higher than A5, no new selection objective derived from Validation results.
Holdback eligibility: A5 is the only planned Holdback method if Goal20 is valid and the frozen method needs no causal defect fix.
If A5 exposes a pre-defined invalidity/safety blocker: stop confirmatory progression with A5_CONFIRMATORY_ELIGIBILITY_FAILED; do NOT fall back to A4; report Validation results truthfully.
